from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, textwrap
root = Path.cwd()
task = root / "reports/T0006"
freeze = json.loads((task / "review-r2-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
status_docs = ["README.md", "docs/implementation_status.md", "docs/handoffs/T0006-proof-verifier.md"]
for name, expected in freeze["input_sha256"].items():
    if name not in status_docs:
        assert sha(root / name) == expected, ("frozen input changed", name)
for name, expected in freeze["history_sha256"].items():
    assert sha(root / name) == expected, ("history changed", name)
print(f'PASS: frozen inputs and {len(freeze["history_sha256"])} historical files unchanged')
result = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout, end="")
print(result.stderr, end="")
assert result.returncode == 0
docs = status_docs + ["reports/T0006/review-r2/review.md"]
links_checked = 0
blocks_checked = 0
for name in docs:
    p = root / name
    data = p.read_text()
    assert data.endswith("\n"), ("missing newline", name)
    assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in data.splitlines()), ("trailing whitespace", name)
    assert "needs_changes" in data
    for href in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)", data):
        href = href.strip("<>").split("#", 1)[0]
        if not href or re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+:", href):
            continue
        assert (p.parent / href).exists(), ("broken local link", name, href)
        links_checked += 1
    for index, code in enumerate(re.findall(chr(96)*3 + r"python\n(.*?)" + chr(96)*3, data, re.S)):
        compile(textwrap.dedent(code), f"{name}:python-block-{index}", "exec")
        blocks_checked += 1
print(f"PASS: diff, text hygiene, {links_checked} local links, {blocks_checked} Python blocks")
runs = {}
for name in ["review-r2-freeze", "review-r2-full", "review-r2-probes"]:
    directory = task / name
    record = json.loads((directory / "record.json").read_text())
    assert record["exit_code"] == 0 and record["status"] == "finished"
    assert record["before"]["source_sha256"] == record["after"]["source_sha256"]
    for stream in ("stdout", "stderr"):
        assert sha(directory / f"{stream}.txt") == record[f"{stream}_sha256"]
    runs[name] = {key: record[key] for key in ("exit_code", "elapsed_s", "started_at_utc", "finished_at_utc", "argv")}
assert "438 passed in 4.05s" in (task / "review-r2-full/stdout.txt").read_text()
assert not (task / "review-r2-full/stderr.txt").read_bytes()
artifacts = docs + ["reports/T0006/review-r2/probe.py", "reports/T0006/review-r2-probes/findings.json",
                    "reports/T0006/review-r2-freeze/audit.json"]
audit = {
    "created_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "result": "NEEDS_CHANGES",
    "task_status": "needs_changes",
    "reviewer": "Codex + gpt-6-astra xhigh",
    "independent_static_reviewer": "/root/review_t0006_tests",
    "product_sha256": sha(root / "src/kmesh/logic/proof.py"),
    "test_sha256": sha(root / "tests/test_proof.py"),
    "product_defect_found": False,
    "acceptance": {"A1": "previously_passed_product_unchanged", "A2": "previously_passed_product_unchanged",
                   "A3": "previously_passed_product_unchanged", "A4": "previously_passed_product_unchanged",
                   "A5": "needs_changes_two_fixtures", "A6": "PASS", "A7": "needs_record_corrections"},
    "findings": [
        {"id": "R2-remaining", "priority": "P2", "location": "tests/test_proof.py:252",
         "reason": "Too-few-premise fixture also has an invalid head; accepts a count-check mutant.",
         "change": "Use valid paired proofs with head bound by first premise, delete only second reference."},
        {"id": "R3-remaining", "priority": "P2", "location": "tests/test_proof.py:928",
         "reason": "Huge positive reference is attached to a fact, so wrong arity returns before reference validation.",
         "change": "Use valid FACT+COPY and change only COPY reference 0 to 10**5000 under pinned 4300."},
        {"id": "R4-remaining", "priority": "P3", "location": "reports/T0006/pi-r2-full/provenance.md",
         "reason": "Incorrect guard root list, test count description, local paths and handoff RUN description.",
         "change": "Append corrections in fresh provenance and execution record; preserve historical reports."}
    ],
    "closed": ["R1 import guards and restoration", "R2 C-group JOIN and renaming",
               "R3 priority, seven giant-integer diagnostics and limit restoration",
               "R4 README default and command, first-round historical corrections"],
    "verification_runs": runs,
    "full_regression": "438 passed in 4.05s; no skips or xfails; stderr empty",
    "pi_r2_runs_verified": len(freeze["pi_r2_records"]),
    "historical_files_preserved": len(freeze["history_sha256"]),
    "old_provenance_append_only_verified": freeze["old_provenance_prefix_preserved"],
    "closure_checks": {"git_diff_check": "PASS", "local_links": links_checked,
                       "python_blocks": blocks_checked, "text_hygiene": "PASS"},
    "artifact_sha256": {name: sha(root / name) for name in artifacts},
    "limits": ["No product or test modification during review", "Not accepted", "No commit or push"],
    "orchestration_note": "First close-check tool submission failed JavaScript parsing before any shell command or RUN was created; corrected quoting and launched the recorded check."
}
target = task / "review-r2/final-audit.json"
with target.open("x") as f:
    json.dump(audit, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print("PASS: final-audit.json written; task remains needs_changes")
